items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Gene Colkit sent him, sent and got him, Fletcher, to come to Detroit

ctx.x: McKinney kept him in the background, in a way. Jean Goldkette So Gene Colkit sent him, sent and got him, Fletcher, to come to Detroit and he took this band and he augmented the band and made it 11 pieces and the band sounded so nice and,
I guess, well, being a black band, too, if you listen to it on the air, you couldn't tell whether it was a black band or white band, in a way. So they --
